workarounds.symptom: bug(ci): ACP agent-loop parity red on main — kernelRounds is half of sharedRounds (23/25 cases)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): preserve feedback input and refresh workflow catalog. Target files: integration-tests/interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts, packages/core/src/config/config.test.ts, packages/core/src/config/config.ts. Preserves every character typed while dismissing the optional Ink feedback prompt, publishes newly registered workflow commands immediately in the model-facing catalog, and makes the teammate parity fixture wait for the leader's recorded answer before releasing the helper. (Ref: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17233)

workarounds.symptom: bug(web-shell): an unconfirmed send in another conversation disables the composer instead of only blocking submit
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(web-shell): keep the composer editable for a foreign unconfirmed send. Target files: packages/web-shell/client/e2e/managed-draft-retry.spec.ts, packages/web-shell/client/hooks/useComposerCore.ts, packages/web-shell/client/components/ChatEditor.tsx. An unconfirmed send no longer locks the composer of conversations it does not belong to. The composer is now replaced by the retry/discard banner only in the conversation that owns the pending record; every other conversation stays editable — typing, pasting and drafting all... (Ref: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17140)

workarounds.symptom: bug(core): a native api.anthropic.com session 400s forever when a persisted thinking part lost its signature
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(core): recover native Anthropic unsigned thinking history. Native Anthropic requests omit unsigned thinking from completed conversation history while retaining visible answers, signed thinking, and completed tool exchanges. workarounds.symptom: ACP session child goes idle-unresponsive after curl/network tool calls; daemon kills it via stats timeout  (agent channel closed mid-request)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(core): avoid UNC lookups for HTTP URLs in AUTO mode. Target files: packages/core/src/permissions/autoMode.test.ts, packages/core/src/permissions/autoMode.ts. Avoid filesystem resolution of HTTP(S) URL arguments during AUTO's protected-write scan. Treat those arguments as uncertain write targets and invoke AUTO classification, preserving the existing fragment and alias checks for other paths. (Ref: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17127)
